about.title: About LUVIKA
about.subtitle: Luvika: Origin of the name and genesis of the project

origin.title: Origin of the name Luvika
origin.content:
The name Luvika comes from the combination of two meaningful elements:
• Luvi, derived from the word Luvila, from the Kikongo language, which means identity, essence, what deeply defines a person.
• Ka, meaning card, referring to an identification medium.

Thus, Luvika can be understood as an identity carried by a card.

This name embodies the project's vision: to offer a modern digital identity, integrated into an NFC card, allowing each individual to introduce themselves, share their professional profile, and enhance their identity in a simple, secure, and innovative way.
Through Luvika, identity ceases to be merely declarative: it becomes digital, portable, and connected, while remaining faithful to its cultural and human essence.

context.title: Context and initial idea
context.content:
Luvika was born from personal and deep reflection. In a moment of calm, I wondered how to enhance my resources, my origins, and my identity, particularly that of my tribe. The initial idea was to create a solution capable of reconnecting people to their roots, allowing them to enhance their history, their village of origin, their tribe, and their clan affiliation.

The initial concept aimed to develop an application capable of clearly identifying a person's origin: their village, their tribe, their clan. Through this platform, these cultural and identity elements could be known, shared, and preserved.

problem.title: Identified problem / limitation of the initial concept
problem.content: However, a deeper analysis led to an important realization: a project focused exclusively on cultural identity risked reaching a limited audience and not encouraging widespread adoption.

transformation.title: Strategic transformation of the project
transformation.content: A strategic transformation of the concept then occurred. Luvika evolved to become a digital professional identifier, based on an NFC card system, while keeping identity as the fundamental basis of its vision. This evolution brought concrete, modern, and universal utility to the project, addressing real professional and commercial needs.

solution.title: Birth of the Luvika solution (NFC and digital identity)
solution.content:
During development, it became clear that simply creating user profiles was not enough. Thus, Luvika structured itself around three distinct plans:
• The Basic plan, intended for users who want a simple and accessible digital presence.
• The Professional plan, offering advanced features, including creating and managing events such as conferences, weddings, parties, or professional meetings.
• The Business plan, designed for companies and users with broader needs, integrating sales tools, visibility, and advanced management.

Thanks to this structure, Luvika has become much more than a simple application. It is now a versatile platform that allows enhancing identity, facilitating professional exchanges, digitizing professional identification cards via NFC technology, and creating economic value for its users.

offers.title: Structure of offers (Basic, Professional, Business)
offers.content:
Luvika offers three pricing plans adapted to different needs:

Basic Plan: For individuals who want a simple and accessible digital presence. Ideal for students, young professionals, and individuals.

Professional Plan: For freelancers, entrepreneurs, and professionals. Offers advanced features like event creation, contact management, and networking tools.

Business Plan: For companies and organizations. Includes team management tools, commercial visibility, and economic value creation.

vision.title: Luvika's vision and mission
vision.content:
Vision: To become the African reference for professional digital identity, combining technological innovation and cultural pride.

Mission: To transform the physical business card into an intelligent, controllable, secure digital identity accessible to everyone — particularly for African entrepreneurs, developers, and leaders.

We believe in a future where digital identity strengthens professional connections while preserving each person's cultural roots.

value.title: Value added for users
value.content:
Luvika brings significant added value to its users:

• Ease of use: Intuitive and multilingual interface, accessible to all
• Enhanced security: Total control over your personal and professional data
• Connectivity: Facilitated professional exchanges thanks to NFC technology
• Visibility: Enhancement of your profile and skills
• Culture: Enhancement of identity and cultural roots
• Economy: Creation of value and commercial opportunities
• Innovation: Cutting-edge technology serving personal and professional development

perspective.title: Project perspective and ambition
perspective.content:
Luvika aims to:

• Revolutionize networking in Africa and worldwide
• Create a professional and culturally rooted digital ecosystem
• Facilitate exchanges between African and international professionals
• Promote African technological innovation
• Contribute to the continent's economic development
• Become an essential platform for professionals worldwide

Our goal is to make Luvika a symbol of African technological excellence, while remaining deeply connected to the values and identity of its users.
